_readme: THE GLOBE TEST: the composite Merrimack (scenes/demos/composite_merrimack.json -- the water read from one
product per layer, the height tree under every CPU reader) seen from a globe camera. It starts over the
east coast of North America with the whole planet in view; TAB steps through the views below, each a
globe camera (`at`: lat, lon, heading, tilt, range in metres from the point), from the planet down to
the composite's three regions and the Merrimack's mouth. The instant is fixed, so a still repeats.
KEYS   TAB the next view   G the debug views (wire, flat, edges, normals, height, depth, meshlets,
albedo, residency of colour / height / land-sea)   mouse drag turns the globe, wheel zooms
Make the products first (network once, cached after):
dotnet run --project harvest/harvest -- compose-water --fidelity harvest/testdata/coast3_3to10m.gafid --out data/composite/coast3

views._at: the planet, the east coast at its centre

views._at: Maine to Florida: the composite's three regions in one view
